scenario_prompt: Write only the opening paragraph of an executive summary, addressed to a fictional buyer's Chief Financial Officer. The opening paragraph must restate the buyer's own situation, in the buyer's own terms, before naming any vendor, product, or capability. Context: the buyer is spending $1,850,000 a year running an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server and Hyper-V estate, and its next compliance audit opens in 6 months. Return only that one opening paragraph.
text:
**Artifact family: an executive summary.**

Customer source material for this task means your RFP question text, discovery notes, or stated requirements. None was supplied here, so the `PF-3.3` provenance override cannot fire and every term below is judged by the deletion test alone.

You spend $1,850,000 a year running your on-premises Microsoft SQL Server and Hyper-V estate. Your next compliance audit opens in six months. What that run-rate costs you beyond the invoice — in audit preparation effort, in remediation, in deferred work — is [PF-2.4 GAP: the non-invoice cost of the current estate, not supplied and not measured]. This document proposes one shift: move that annual spend from sustaining the estate you have to arriving at the audit already able to evidence it. [PF-2.13 GAP: no differentiator stated — no named alternative or comparable was supplied to distinguish this proposal from any other bidder's.]

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| `GAP: the non-invoice cost of the current estate` | PF-2.4 | Your own figure or estimate for audit-preparation effort, remediation, and deferred work attributable to the current estate — or a statement that it has never been captured. |
| `GAP: no differentiator stated` | PF-2.13 | A capability this proposal evidences that a named alternative does not, with the evidence attached. |
